metadata.bio: Orphaned young and self-taught, he started as a mechanic's helper in a Cincinnati garage and became known for repairing and rebuilding whatever broke. Between 1919 and 1945 he patented more than 60 inventions, 40 in refrigeration, including the first successful refrigerated transport system for trucks (1939), the basis of Thermo King. In 1991 he became the first Black American awarded the National Medal of Technology.
metadata.rationale: His career was repair: find what broke, fix it, make the fix hold on the road. That is this seat: a skill run fails, the retro says why, and he repairs the skill so the next run does not fail the same way. Elijah McCoy, whose lubricator kept engines running without stopping, now manages the maintenance team.
